meaning: relating to the short-term methods chosen to gain an immediate advantage, as distinct from overall strategy
sentence: The company made a tactical withdrawal to the higher ground before dawn.

meaning: sharply sour to the taste, or cuttingly sharp in speech; also a small open pastry case with a filling
sentence: Her tart reply ended the argument at once.

meaning: past tense of teach — gave instruction in a subject or skill to someone
sentence: She taught mathematics at the academy for twenty years.

meaning: pulled or stretched tight, with no slack left in it
sentence: The rope went taut as the boat pulled away from the jetty.

meaning: holding firmly to a purpose or a grip and not easily letting go
sentence: Her tenacious defence of the forward post saved the whole platoon.

meaning: gentleness and warmth of feeling towards someone; also soreness felt when a part of the body is touched
sentence: He spoke to the injured cadet with unexpected tenderness.

meaning: only slightly warm, or showing very little enthusiasm
sentence: The proposal met with a tepid response from the committee.

meaning: the part of the brain that receives sensory signals and relays them on to the cerebral cortex
sentence: Almost every sensory signal passes through the thalamus before it reaches the cortex.

meaning: up to the point in time that something happens, the short informal counterpart of until; also a shop's cash drawer, or to cultivate land for crops
sentence: He tilled the fields till dusk, then emptied the till and locked the shop.

meaning: lack of courage or self-confidence, a shrinking from risk and from asserting oneself
sentence: His timidity kept him silent even when he knew the answer.

meaning: a wrongful act other than a breach of contract, for which the injured party can sue for damages
sentence: Negligence causing injury is the commonest tort in civil law.

meaning: a rich, dense cake made with ground nuts or breadcrumbs in place of flour, usually layered and iced
sentence: She ordered a slice of chocolate torte after dinner.

meaning: causing or involving great physical or mental suffering
sentence: The last kilometre of the endurance run was torturous.

meaning: letting light through so that whatever lies behind can be seen clearly; also open to scrutiny, or so obvious that the motive behind it is plain
sentence: The selection process must be transparent if candidates are to trust it.

meaning: aggressively defiant, quick to argue or pick a fight
sentence: The truculent recruit argued with every order he was given.

meaning: cloudy or muddy with stirred-up sediment, so that a liquid cannot be seen through
sentence: After the storm the river ran turbid and brown.

meaning: acting under threat or coercion, and so against one's own free will
sentence: A confession signed under duress carries no weight in court.

meaning: not interested, paying no attention because the matter seems dull
sentence: He was wholly uninterested in the lecture and stared out of the window.

meaning: up to the point in time that something happens, the full form preferred in formal writing and at the start of a sentence
sentence: Until the orders arrive, no one is to leave the post.

meaning: showed someone the way to a place, or marked the beginning of a new period
sentence: The reforms ushered in a decade of steady growth.

meaning: a flat blade turned by wind or water, as on a windmill, a turbine or a weathercock
sentence: The weather vane on the roof swung round to the north.

meaning: a blood vessel carrying blood back towards the heart; also a seam of ore in rock, or a particular style or mood
sentence: The miners struck a rich vein of copper.

meaning: the decision reached by a jury or a judge, or any considered judgement on a matter
sentence: The jury returned a verdict of not guilty.

meaning: causing annoyance or worry; in law, of a case brought merely to harass rather than on real grounds
sentence: The court dismissed the claim as vexatious.

meaning: experienced indirectly, through watching or imagining another person's actions rather than one's own
sentence: He took vicarious pleasure in his son's success on the parade ground.

meaning: the deliberate giving up of a right or claim, or the document recording that surrender
sentence: Every participant signed a waiver before the climb.

meaning: a written term of a contract by which a seller promises to repair or replace a faulty article within a stated period
sentence: The radio set is still under warranty, so the repair will cost nothing.

meaning: the crosswise threads carried over and under the warp in weaving cloth
sentence: The weaver drew the weft through with a shuttle.

meaning: strange and unsettling in a way that is hard to account for
sentence: A weird green light hung over the valley at dawn.

meaning: in a way that uses far more words than the matter needs
sentence: He answered wordily when a single sentence would have done.

meaning: causing anxiety or unease
sentence: The drop in rainfall this year is worrisome.

meaning: seaweed cast up on the shore; also destruction or ruin, as in the phrase wrack and ruin
sentence: The empty mill had gone to wrack and ruin.
